title: VTP Configuration
description: Configure VTP server, client, and transparent modes and manage the VLAN database over trunks.
scenario: Configure VTP server, client, and transparent modes and manage the VLAN database over trunks.

concepts.title: VTP Server
concepts.body: Server stores the VLAN database and advertises it. Create VLANs here and they propagate to the whole domain.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# vtp mode server
SW1(config)# vtp domain CCNA
SW1(config)# vlan 20
SW1(config-vlan)# name ENGINEERING

concepts.title: VTP Client
concepts.body: Client receives VLANs from the server. Cannot create VLANs on its own.
concepts.code:
SW2(config)# vtp mode client
SW2(config)# vtp domain CCNA

concepts.title: VTP Transparent
concepts.body: Transparent keeps VLANs local and forwards VTP messages but does not accept domain VLAN updates.

concepts.title: VTP Domain & Password
concepts.body: All switches share the same domain name and password. Mismatches corrupt VLAN database sync.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# vtp domain CCNA
SW1(config)# vtp domain cisco
SW1(config)# vtp pruning
